Subject: Starnet technical walkthrough — proposed times + AV/room check

Hi Oliver,

Thanks again for confirming interest in a technical walkthrough on Feb 24. We'd like to cover the inference routing, fallback policies, and KV cache behavior with a short live demo (30–40 minutes) followed by Q&A.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Feb 24 • 10:00–11:00
- Wed Feb 24 • 14:00–15:00

Primary plan: Google Meet (company policy allows Meet for sessions with external partners). Backup: Zoom link if your org prefers it. Can you confirm which you prefer? Also, can you confirm if any of your team need calendar invites with an ICS? We can attach one.

Logistics/asks for our side:
- Connor, can you reserve a conference room near HQ with a working HDMI and run an AV check the morning of the 24th? If room hardware is flaky we’ll switch to the backup plan (individual laptops + hotspot).
- Aisha, I attached a short agenda (starnet_deepdive_agenda_v1.pdf). Please review and flag any changes.

Attachments: starnet_deepdive_agenda_v1.pdf (draft)

Thanks — if one of the proposed slots works, I’ll send the invite and both Meet + Zoom links (Meet primary).

Best,
Soojin

1) Primary: Google Meet (meet.google.com/rwd-starnet) hosted by Redwood.
2) Backup 1: Zoom meeting (zoom.us/j/999999999) — will be enabled if Meet has issues.

- Reserve a room for 14:00 PT (will probably be room 3B or alternate).
- Run an AV + network check 30 minutes before (13:30 PT). If HDMI or mics are flaky we’ll move to room 5A.

I’ll attach the ICS and the agenda in the invite. Oliver/av@starnet.io — would you like us to run a 5–10 minute connectivity check with you on Tuesday just to confirm Meet/server handshake?

Thanks,
